blocks.heading: incident.io cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price incident.io against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Basic until a gated capability (on-call and paging (Basic, Team, Pro, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, change and problem management, infrastructure monitoring) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: On-call paging is an add-on (+list price–list price), not included in the list price Team floor. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want incident command in Slack more than a paging-first ops cloud requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
